title: The connect frame
description: Local-bridge-only control frame for the optional helper process (Safari and short-lived plugins). Says where the broker is and what secret to present. Not part of the tunnel protocol; the broker refuses it.

broker.description: The address of the broker, for example ws://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/tunnel.

secret.description: The secret of the grant, for the instance of the surface.

surface.description: The surface the plugin speaks for, when the local bridge was not told.

channel.description: The channel of the surface, when the local bridge was not told.
